transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. I guess I'm here because... well, things just haven't been great lately. 

I've been... catching myself having these thoughts. Just... thinking it might be easier if I just didn't wake up. Um... sometimes on the drive home from school, I just start wondering if my family, or my students... if they'd be better off without me around. 

It... it scares me, honestly. Because I really don't want to act on it or anything, but... yeah. That's why I'm here.
How long have you been having these thoughts?

Um... a while. Maybe... a year and a half? A little over that, actually. Like a year and seven months, I think. 

It... it started back when I took over this STEM assessment redesign at school. I was already doing my regular teaching load, and... yeah. Since around then.
Have you noticed any changes in the things you enjoy doing, or have you been feeling less interested in activities that usually bring you pleasure?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... I used to look forward to a few things. Like softball, and my book club. I have a garden... and I help with the robotics club at school. 

But... I don't know. Now I mostly just cancel. Or if I do go, I'm really just going through the motions. It just... none of it really feels enjoyable anymore.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight recently?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I haven't really been keeping track, but... my clothes are definitely looser. I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything. It's just... most days at school, I don't really eat until the afternoon. I just sort of... forget, or I just don't want to.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy level or how active you've been lately?

Um... yeah. I guess I've been pretty tired. 

Just... by the time I get through teaching, and then if there's a department meeting... I just feel really heavy. Like my body is just dragging. 

Even little things... like making dinner, or just trying to answer a couple of emails from parents... it just feels like too much effort. Like climbing a hill or something. So... yeah, my energy is pretty low.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge most of the time?
Um... no, not really. I wouldn't say I feel anxious. Just... tired, mostly.
Have you been feeling consistently sad or depressed most days?
Um... I don't know. I wouldn't really say sad. I haven't been crying or... anything like that. I mostly just feel kind of... blank, I guess. Or just tired, like I said.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from things that normally would bring you happiness?

I guess so. Um... I used to look forward to things, like... playing softball, or my book club. Working in the garden... even the robotics club I help with at school. 

But now I mostly just... cancel. Or if I have to be there, I'm just going through the motions. None of it really feels enjoyable anymore.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt worse than you do now?

Um... no, not really worse. It's just been... steady, I guess. Like this. For a while now. 

Um... maybe a year and seven months? That's when I had to take over the STEM assessment redesign... on top of my regular teaching load. So it's just been like this since then.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual?
Um... no, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty about things?

Um... I guess so. Just... mostly with work. If a lesson goes badly, or... if a student looks confused, I take it pretty hard. I just feel like I'm letting everyone down. I end up replaying it in my head a lot. It just makes me feel like I'm a terrible teacher... and a bad mother, I guess.
Have you been having these thoughts about not waking up or your family being better off without you nearly every day?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Most days. It's... it's actually kind of why I'm here. I just... I keep catching myself thinking it would be easier if I didn't wake up. 

And sometimes on the drive home... I just wonder if my family and my students would be better off without me. It... it scares me, honestly. Because I don't want to act on it or anything. But... yeah.
Do you think about death often, aside from thinking it would be easier if you didn't wake up or your family would be better off without you?
No... not really. Just... just what I said before.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or look forward to?

Um... not really anymore. I used to look forward to things. Like playing softball, or going to my book club... I have a garden, and I help with the robotics club at school. But... I don't know. 

Lately, I mostly just go through the motions. Or I just cancel. It just... none of it really feels enjoyable anymore.
Are there any small things that still give you some pleasure?
Um... no. Like I just said, not really. Even the little things, like... my garden. I just don't get anything out of it right now. I'm just... going through the motions with all of it.
Would you say these thoughts of not waking up or your family being better off without you are present nearly every day, or are they intermittent?

Um... probably almost every day lately. I just... I catch myself thinking it would be easier if I didn't wake up. And sometimes on the drive home, I start wondering if my family... and my students... would just be better off without me. It... it scares me, honestly. I don't want to act on it or anything. It just... happens.
Have you experienced a significant loss of interest in activities you once enjoyed for most of the day, nearly every day?

Um... yeah. Like I was saying earlier... I just don't really care about the things I used to. The softball, my book club, helping out with robotics... I just cancel mostly. Or I just sit through it without really being there. So... yeah, it's pretty much every day.
Would you say these thoughts and feelings have been present for most of the day?
Um... yeah. Most of the day, I guess. I just... I wake up feeling like this, and it stays with me.
Do you feel sad most of the day?
Um... I don't really know if sad is the right word. I'm not sure. I don't really cry or anything... I just feel kind of... blank, I guess.

Um... like I just said, I don't really know. It's not exactly sadness, just... that blank feeling. I don't really have a better word for it.
